target_customer: Web users who wanted recommended related sites while browsing
problem: Finding relevant sites related to the page you are on required searching. Youlicit used a Firefox plug-in and community recommendations to surface related sites without a search.
business_model: Free consumer recommendation service with widgets for site owners, monetization not stated
product_category: Social bookmarking and web content recommendation

technical_complexity.rationale: Needed a browser extension, a relatedness ranking over community recommendations, RSS feeds and widgets. Relevance quality, which Genbeta noted was weak for Spanish sites, was the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Value depended on a community of recommenders, which was not yet built, and the extension was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing an incumbent copying or buying Youlicit.

market_need_then: Social bookmarking and discovery were active in 2007 and 2008, but no usage numbers for Youlicit were found.

branding.domain_note: youlicit.com is now redirected to an unrelated pet site, so the domain lapsed and was reused

identity.logo: Firefox plug-in buttons that light up while browsing, per the YC description

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by Mashable and Genbeta in July 2007. No further community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Small press mention only and an unusual coined name with no sourced meaning.

outcome_analysis: Youlicit launched its Firefox based recommendation tool by July 2007, before joining the Summer 2008 YC batch. It took a YC seed investment in June 2008 per CB Insights and later went inactive. No post mortem or press about the shutdown was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are asserted. The unusual coined name and a community dependent product with no visible traction may have contributed but are not sourced.
notes: Seed round rests on a single database (CB Insights) with no amount. Dead-site note: youlicit.com now 301 redirects to an unrelated site. The YC page lists team size 2 but four founders. A Genbeta post dated 2007-07-12 shows the product existed before the batch, so founded_year is left null. Competitor list is empty because the dated Genbeta article names no rival services and no other dated rival source was found. Confidence is low because founders lack backgrounds and funding amount is unknown.
